picks.headline: Bringing Design Systems into Figma Make
picks.excerpt: Figma Designer Advocate Anthony DiSpezio walks through building a Make kit so Figma Make generates on-brand prototypes from your own design system components, styles and variables instead of generic AI output.
picks.rationale: First-party, step-by-step method to make Figma Make output on-brand — directly changes how a design-system team works tomorrow.

picks.headline: Adobe releases After Effects 26.5, plus experimental new AI Assistant
picks.excerpt: After Effects 26.5 ships new motion graphics and compositing features, and the current beta adds an agentic AI Assistant that can drive the app from natural-language instructions.
picks.rationale: A shipped major-app release plus an agentic assistant that drives After Effects by prompt — concrete news motion designers can install today.

picks.headline: Slack can now vibe-code interactive charts and reports inside chats
picks.excerpt: Slack's new Surfaces feature lets anyone generate interactive charts, dashboards and mini-apps from a prompt directly in a channel — generative UI landing inside the tool teams already live in.
picks.rationale: Generative UI arrives where teams already work; designers now have to think about interfaces non-designers prompt into existence.

picks.headline: InfinitForm brings determinism back to generative design
picks.excerpt: InfinitForm's cloud platform positions AI as an assistant rather than the engine of generative design, aiming for repeatable, manufacturable geometry instead of one-off organic blobs engineers can't reproduce.
picks.rationale: Counter-narrative to AI-as-generator: repeatable, manufacturable geometry is the constraint industrial designers actually ship against.

picks.headline: 8 voice AI UX patterns
picks.excerpt: Sharang Sharma maps eight emerging voice-AI UX patterns, the agent roles users perceive behind each, and the key design decisions and limitations that come with them.
picks.rationale: A reusable pattern vocabulary for voice agents — the closest thing to a spec sheet for designers starting conversational work.
